rationale: PCT01 flagged the quarter because extracted pct_of_net_assets sums to about 215.2, but the raw Schedule of Investments itself reports Total Investments at 215.2% of net assets. The balance sheet anchors support the percentage: total investments at fair value are 2,918,584 and total net assets are 1,356,005, giving approximately 215.2%. The extracted value is source-consistent; the flag reflects an over-narrow expected-range check for a leveraged BDC portfolio rather than a data defect.
